analysis.visual_description: On the almanack. The penny almanac open at Friday. A printed line sits in the day's space. The pen has not touched it. Candle.
On the almanack. One line added beneath the printed moon. No sum beside it. No second house.
On the almanack. The rest of the Friday space is blank. The pen is set in the gutter. Sunday's letter is at the edge of the desk, unfolded, and not in the almanac.
